decision.reason: [ev-53f0754c524f] is a single CLI changelog line that combines two dependency bumps (Kubernetes v1.34.0 and Go 1.25.0) and points to PR #5499 for details. It gives only the new versions. It does not give the previous versions, and it does not say whether any supported Kubernetes cluster version range, behaviour or configuration changed. Without that, an engineer cannot write a typed change (before/after) or an applicability condition. Evidence such as a compatibility or supported-versions statement, or the PR contents, is needed.
